rule_or_pattern: Drop (a) doubled readings: label with two or more immediate word repeats, regex (\b\S+) \1\b.*(\b\S+) \2\b ; (b) lines flagged C:cph_out_of_range whose crop cuts the letters (vertical clip); (c) gutter-crossing lines (pool rule). Additionally relabel '§' misread as digit 8 between numbers: regex (\d) 8 (\d) → '\1 § \2' (e.g. 'ἄρθρῳ 34 8 1').
notes: One-page 1896 bill report in polytonic two-column print; the plain body lines read correctly (1-21, 30-32, 35, 38-40). Defects: doubled-word labels (26 'πρὸς πρὸς αὐτὴν αὐτὴν προβαίνει προβαίνει', 27), crops clipped to half-height (34, 37) and one label for a different line (29), gutter-crossing joins (22-25, 28). The paragraph sign § is read as '8' everywhere (28, 33, 36).
